source: Curated major global events; dates are UTC calendar dates.

events.name: Galveston hurricane
events.description: A hurricane struck Galveston, Texas, killing thousands and destroying much of the city.

events.name: Queen Victoria dies
events.description: Queen Victoria died at Osborne House, ending a 63-year reign.

events.name: First transatlantic radio signal
events.description: Guglielmo Marconi received the first transatlantic radio signal at Signal Hill, Newfoundland.

events.name: Wright brothers' first powered flight
events.description: The Wright Flyer made the first controlled, sustained powered flight at Kitty Hawk.

events.name: Einstein publishes special relativity
events.description: Albert Einstein published the special theory of relativity in Annalen der Physik.

events.name: San Francisco earthquake and fire
events.description: A major earthquake and subsequent fires devastated San Francisco.

events.name: Panic of 1907
events.description: A run on New York's Knickerbocker Trust triggered the Panic of 1907 and a nationwide banking crisis.

events.name: Messina earthquake and tsunami
events.description: An earthquake and tsunami devastated Messina and nearby communities in Sicily and Calabria.

events.name: The Rite of Spring premieres
events.description: Igor Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring premiered in Paris, provoking a famous audience riot.

events.name: Federal Reserve Act signed
events.description: President Woodrow Wilson signed the Federal Reserve Act, creating the Federal Reserve System.

events.name: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
events.description: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria was assassinated in Sarajevo, setting off the July Crisis.

events.name: October Revolution
events.description: The Bolsheviks seized power in Petrograd, beginning the Russian Revolution.

events.name: Armistice ends World War I
events.description: Germany signed the Armistice of Compiegne, ending fighting in World War I.

events.name: Eddington eclipse confirms general relativity
events.description: Arthur Eddington's solar-eclipse observations confirmed Einstein's prediction of light bending.

events.name: Treaty of Versailles signed
events.description: The Treaty of Versailles formally ended World War I and imposed terms on Germany.

events.name: Tutankhamun's tomb discovered
events.description: Howard Carter discovered the tomb of Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings.

events.name: Great Kanto earthquake
events.description: The Great Kanto earthquake devastated Tokyo and Yokohama.

events.name: The Jazz Singer premieres
events.description: The Jazz Singer premiered, introducing synchronized sound to mainstream feature films.

events.name: Penicillin discovered
events.description: Alexander Fleming observed that Penicillium mould inhibited bacterial growth.

events.name: Wall Street Crash
events.description: The New York Stock Exchange suffered the crash that preceded the Great Depression.

events.name: China floods
events.description: Severe flooding along the Yangtze and Huai rivers affected millions across central China.

events.name: Hitler appointed German chancellor
events.description: President Paul von Hindenburg appointed Adolf Hitler chancellor of Germany.

events.name: US national bank holiday
events.description: President Franklin D. Roosevelt declared a national bank holiday to stabilize the banking system.

events.name: Spanish Civil War begins
events.description: A military uprising in Spanish Morocco began the Spanish Civil War.

events.name: Nuclear fission discovered
events.description: Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann discovered nuclear fission of uranium.

events.name: World War II begins in Europe
events.description: Germany invaded Poland, beginning World War II in Europe.

events.name: Bretton Woods Conference concludes
events.description: The Bretton Woods Conference concluded with agreements creating the IMF and World Bank.

events.name: Victory in Europe Day
events.description: Germany surrendered unconditionally, ending the war in Europe.

events.name: Trinity test
events.description: The first detonation of a nuclear weapon took place at Alamogordo, New Mexico.

events.name: Atomic bomb dropped on Hiroshima
events.description: The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, Japan.

events.name: United Nations founded
events.description: The UN Charter entered into force, formally establishing the United Nations.

events.name: India independence
events.description: India became independent from British rule and a new sovereign state was established.

events.name: Transistor demonstrated
events.description: Bell Labs demonstrated the first working point-contact transistor.

events.name: Mahatma Gandhi assassinated
events.description: Mahatma Gandhi was assassinated in New Delhi by Nathuram Godse.

events.name: State of Israel proclaimed
events.description: David Ben-Gurion proclaimed the establishment of the State of Israel.

events.name: NATO founded
events.description: Twelve nations signed the North Atlantic Treaty in Washington, D.C.

events.name: People's Republic of China founded
events.description: Mao Zedong proclaimed the People's Republic of China in Beijing.

events.name: North Sea flood
events.description: A storm surge flooded the Netherlands, Belgium, and the United Kingdom, causing major loss of life.

events.name: DNA double helix published
events.description: James Watson and Francis Crick published the double-helix structure of DNA in Nature.

events.name: Elvis Presley's first single
events.description: Elvis Presley's first commercial single, 'That's All Right,' was released on Sun Records.

events.name: Bandung Conference opens
events.description: Asian and African states convened in Bandung, Indonesia, to promote decolonization and cooperation.

events.name: Sputnik 1 launched
events.description: The Soviet Union placed the first artificial satellite into Earth orbit.

events.name: Sputnik 2 carries Laika
events.description: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 2 with Laika, the first animal to orbit Earth.

events.name: Valdivia earthquake
events.description: The 1960 Valdivia earthquake, the most powerful ever recorded, struck southern Chile and generated a Pacific-wide tsunami.

events.name: First human spaceflight
events.description: Yuri Gagarin completed one orbit of Earth aboard Vostok 1.

events.name: Berlin Wall construction begins
events.description: East Germany began constructing the Berlin Wall, sealing the border between East and West Berlin.

events.name: Cuban Missile Crisis ends
events.description: The Cuban Missile Crisis ended after the Soviet Union agreed to withdraw its missiles from Cuba.

events.name: March on Washington
events.description: More than 200,000 people gathered in Washington, D.C.; Martin Luther King Jr. delivered 'I Have a Dream'.

events.name: Assassination of John F. Kennedy
events.description: President John F. Kennedy was assassinated in Dallas, Texas.

events.name: The Beatles on The Ed Sullivan Show
events.description: The Beatles made their first live American television appearance on The Ed Sullivan Show.

events.name: US Civil Rights Act signed
events.description: President Lyndon B. Johnson signed the Civil Rights Act into law.

events.name: Second Vatican Council closes
events.description: The Second Vatican Council closed after four sessions and major reforms in the Catholic Church.

events.name: Assassination of Martin Luther King Jr.
events.description: Martin Luther King Jr. was assassinated in Memphis, Tennessee.

events.name: Stonewall uprising
events.description: The Stonewall uprising began after a police raid on a gay bar in New York City.

events.name: Apollo 11 launch
events.description: Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center on the first crewed Moon-landing mission.

events.name: Apollo 11 Moon landing
events.description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Lunar Module Eagle on the Moon while Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit.

events.name: Woodstock opens
events.description: The Woodstock Music and Art Fair opened on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

events.name: Bhola cyclone
events.description: The Bhola cyclone struck East Pakistan and the Bay of Bengal, causing one of the deadliest tropical-cyclone disasters.

events.name: Nixon shock
events.description: President Nixon ended the dollar's convertibility into gold, ending the Bretton Woods system.

events.name: China seated at the United Nations
events.description: The United Nations General Assembly seated the People's Republic of China and expelled the Republic of China.

events.name: Paris Peace Accords signed
events.description: The United States, North Vietnam, South Vietnam, and the Viet Cong signed the Paris Peace Accords.

events.name: OPEC oil embargo
events.description: Arab oil-producing states imposed an oil embargo, triggering the 1973 oil crisis.

events.name: Tangshan earthquake
events.description: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck Tangshan, China, causing massive casualties.

events.name: Star Wars premieres
events.description: Star Wars premiered in U.S. theaters, launching a global science-fiction franchise.

events.name: Voyager 1 launched
events.description: NASA launched Voyager 1 on a mission to the outer planets and interstellar space.

events.name: Iranian Revolution
events.description: The Iranian Revolution culminated in the collapse of the Pahlavi monarchy.

events.name: Volcker shock begins
events.description: The Federal Reserve under Paul Volcker began a sustained campaign of high interest rates to break inflation.

events.name: Mount St. Helens eruption
events.description: Mount St. Helens erupted in Washington State, removing its summit and spreading ash across the region.

events.name: First Space Shuttle launch
events.description: Space Shuttle Columbia launched on STS-1, the first flight of the reusable shuttle program.

events.name: Royal wedding of Charles and Diana
events.description: Prince Charles married Lady Diana Spencer in a globally televised ceremony at St Paul's Cathedral.

events.name: Latin American debt crisis
events.description: Mexico suspended payments on its foreign debt, setting off the Latin American debt crisis.

events.name: Nevado del Ruiz eruption
events.description: A volcanic eruption triggered deadly lahars that buried the town of Armero, Colombia.

events.name: Black Monday
events.description: Global stock markets crashed on a single day, with the Dow Jones falling more than 20%.

events.name: Berlin Wall opened
events.description: East Germany opened its border crossings, leading to the fall of the Berlin Wall.

events.name: Hubble Space Telescope launched
events.description: The Hubble Space Telescope was deployed into low Earth orbit aboard Space Shuttle Discovery.

events.name: German reunification
events.description: East and West Germany formally reunified.

events.name: Soviet Union dissolved
events.description: The Supreme Soviet formally dissolved the Soviet Union, creating fifteen independent republics.

events.name: Black Wednesday
events.description: Britain was forced out of the European Exchange Rate Mechanism on Black Wednesday.

events.name: Nelson Mandela inaugurated
events.description: Nelson Mandela was inaugurated as South Africa's first Black president.

events.name: Kobe earthquake
events.description: The Great Hanshin earthquake struck Kobe and the surrounding region in Japan.

events.name: First exoplanet around a Sun-like star
events.description: Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz announced the first exoplanet orbiting a Sun-like star, 51 Pegasi b.

events.name: Dolly the sheep announced
events.description: The Roslin Institute announced the birth of Dolly, the first mammal cloned from an adult cell.

events.name: Diana, Princess of Wales, dies
events.description: Diana, Princess of Wales, died after a car crash in Paris.

events.name: Asian financial crisis
events.description: Currency and market turmoil spread across East and Southeast Asia.

events.name: Euro introduced
events.description: The euro was introduced as the common currency of eleven European Union member states.

events.name: Dot-com peak
events.description: The Nasdaq Composite reached its dot-com bubble peak before a multi-year decline.

events.name: Human genome draft announced
events.description: The Human Genome Project and Celera jointly announced a working draft of the human genome.

events.name: September 11 attacks
events.description: Coordinated terrorist attacks struck the World Trade Center and the Pentagon.

events.name: Argentina sovereign default
events.description: Argentina defaulted on its sovereign debt amid a severe economic and political crisis.

events.name: Human Genome Project completed
events.description: The international consortium announced that the human genome had been sequenced to near-completion.

events.name: Spirit rover lands on Mars
events.description: NASA's Spirit rover landed on Mars to begin the Mars Exploration Rover mission.

events.name: Facebook launches
events.description: Mark Zuckerberg launched Facebook from his Harvard dormitory.

events.name: Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami
events.description: A magnitude 9.1 earthquake off Sumatra triggered a tsunami that devastated coastlines across the Indian Ocean.

events.name: Hurricane Katrina
events.description: Hurricane Katrina made landfall on the U.S. Gulf Coast, breaching levees and flooding New Orleans.

events.name: iPhone announced
events.description: Steve Jobs unveiled the first iPhone at Macworld in San Francisco.

events.name: Beijing Olympics open
events.description: The Beijing Summer Olympics opened with a widely watched opening ceremony.

events.name: Lehman Brothers collapse
events.description: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy, precipitating the global financial crisis.

events.name: AIG rescued
events.description: The U.S. government rescued American International Group with an $85 billion emergency loan.

events.name: Barack Obama elected
events.description: Barack Obama was elected the first African American president of the United States.

events.name: Flash Crash
events.description: U.S. stock indices plunged and recovered within minutes in the 2010 Flash Crash.

events.name: Tohoku earthquake and tsunami
events.description: A magnitude 9.0 earthquake and tsunami struck northeastern Japan, causing the Fukushima nuclear accident.

events.name: William and Catherine marry
events.description: Prince William married Catherine Middleton at Westminster Abbey.

events.name: Osama bin Laden killed
events.description: United States forces killed Osama bin Laden in Abbottabad, Pakistan.

events.name: Higgs boson discovery announced
events.description: CERN announced the observation of a new particle consistent with the Higgs boson.

events.name: Draghi's 'whatever it takes' pledge
events.description: ECB President Mario Draghi pledged to do 'whatever it takes' to preserve the euro.

events.name: Curiosity rover lands on Mars
events.description: NASA's Curiosity rover landed in Gale Crater to study Mars' habitability.

events.name: Pope Francis elected
events.description: Cardinal Jorge Mario Bergoglio was elected Pope Francis.

events.name: China Black Monday
events.description: A sharp selloff in Chinese equities triggered a global market slump.

events.name: LIGO detects gravitational waves
events.description: The LIGO observatories detected gravitational waves from merging black holes for the first time.

events.name: Gravitational waves announced
events.description: LIGO reported the first direct detection of gravitational waves from merging black holes.

events.name: Brexit referendum
events.description: The United Kingdom voted to leave the European Union.

events.name: First image of a black hole
events.description: The Event Horizon Telescope collaboration released the first image of a black hole's shadow.

events.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral fire
events.description: A fire severely damaged Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris.

events.name: SARS-CoV-2 genome shared
events.description: Chinese researchers shared the first complete genome sequence of SARS-CoV-2.

events.name: COVID-19 market crash
events.description: Global equity markets began a rapid sell-off as the COVID-19 pandemic spread.

events.name: US presidential election
events.description: Joe Biden defeated incumbent Donald Trump in the US presidential election.

events.name: James Webb Space Telescope launched
events.description: NASA launched the James Webb Space Telescope aboard an Ariane 5 rocket.

events.name: 2022 rate shock
events.description: Global markets began repricing sharply as central banks signaled rapid rate increases.

events.name: Russia invades Ukraine
events.description: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

events.name: JWST first science images
events.description: NASA released the first full-color science images from the James Webb Space Telescope.

events.name: Queen Elizabeth II dies
events.description: Queen Elizabeth II died at Balmoral Castle after a 70-year reign.

events.name: Fusion ignition achieved
events.description: The National Ignition Facility achieved the first controlled fusion reaction that produced more energy than the laser energy delivered to the target.

events.name: Silicon Valley Bank collapses
events.description: Silicon Valley Bank collapsed after a bank run, becoming the largest U.S. bank failure since 2008.

events.name: Finland joins NATO
events.description: Finland formally joined NATO, ending decades of military non-alignment.

events.name: Euclid space telescope launched
events.description: The European Space Agency launched the Euclid space telescope to map dark matter and dark energy.

events.name: Chang'e 6 returns lunar far-side samples
events.description: China's Chang'e 6 mission returned the first samples from the Moon's far side.

events.name: Paris Olympics open
events.description: The Paris Summer Olympics opened with an opening ceremony on the River Seine.

events.name: Yen carry unwind
events.description: A sharp unwind of yen-funded positions triggered a global risk-off move.

events.name: Starship booster caught at launch tower
events.description: SpaceX's Starship Super Heavy booster returned to its launch tower and was caught by mechanical arms.
